customers_say: Customers find the smart door lock to be of good quality, with straightforward installation and ease of use, particularly noting the near-instant fingerprint unlock feature. They appreciate its comprehensive features and security capabilities, with one customer highlighting the anti-pry/tamper alarm, while also noting its stylish appearance. The functionality receives positive feedback, with one customer describing it as a must-have for every home. However, the battery life receives criticism, with customers reporting very short battery duration of 30-45 days.

reviews.title: Very good product and worth every penny.
reviews.body: The product is very good, it works with multiple keyless options like fingerprint, numeric lock, we can lock and unlock from mobile app also. We charged the battery almost 6-7 months back but still it is working with out any issue. Worth the amount.
